title: Sweetcorn Fritters
description: Crispy veggie fritters of tinned sweetcorn, finely grated hard cheese and eggs. Ready in minutes — great for breakfast topped with bacon and avocado.

ingredients.text: 50g hard cheese (Cheddar or similar), finely grated

steps: Tip the sweetcorn kernels into a bowl.
Grate the cheese as finely as possible — this binds the fritters. Add the cheese and eggs to the sweetcorn and stir vigorously.
Heat a teaspoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Ladle spoonfuls of the mix (about 2 dessert spoons) into the pan, leaving space between them.
Cook for 3–4 minutes on each side until set and golden brown. Drain off excess liquid between batches.
Serve hot, straight from the pan.
notes: Makes 8 fritters. Per fritter estimate. Great sprinkled with chilli flakes or lime juice.
